items.title: A power-torsion module embeds into a sum of injective hulls
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a module annihilated by a power of the maximal ideal embeds into a finite sum of copies of the injective hull of the residue field (author lemma at source lines 1022-1029, label lemma-torsion-submodule-sum-injective-hulls). The proof (source lines 1031-1039) identifies the target as the injective hull of the maximal-ideal torsion of the module and concludes injectivity of the map from essentialness of that torsion (proof lines 1031-1038). The essentialness step is the substance. H3.
